SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
